tool_signatures.name: agent_bootstrap
tool_signatures.description: Mandatory before Llama work: fetch the authenticated two-part private Brain (Investment Framework V3 + Llama Command operating skill), a compact Live Deal Page schema index, runtime contract, and visible Llama OS skills. Read exact Page fields separately with get_live_deal_page_schema.

tool_signatures.name: auth_status
tool_signatures.description: Verify Command credentials and current user identity.

tool_signatures.name: create_deal
tool_signatures.description: Create one Deal intent. Core owns Drive, initial resources, idempotency, and Events.

tool_signatures.name: feedback_show
tool_signatures.description: Read your own submitted friction report and resolution using its feedback ID.

tool_signatures.name: feedback_submit
tool_signatures.description: Report concrete UX friction experienced by a user, agent or both, even if the task succeeded. Separate observations from guesses. One report per obstacle; never include secrets, transcripts, files or raw command arguments. Failures must not block the original task or trigger recursive reporting. Reuse submission_id for retries. Host identity/version is captured when available; unknown versions stay absent.

tool_signatures.name: get_deal_memory
tool_signatures.description: Read the complete canonical Markdown Deal Story and its opaque concurrency version. A returned placeholder is an existing Story whose version is required for a write; only 404 means no Story exists.

tool_signatures.name: get_live_deal_page_schema
tool_signatures.description: Read the Live Deal Page schema progressively. Call with no selector for the compact index; before page.patch, request only exact fields or one section. This is read-only context, not a fifth Deal action.

tool_signatures.name: object_inspect
tool_signatures.description: Explain a Command URL or object before guessing that it is broken.

tool_signatures.name: pitch_finalize
tool_signatures.description: Clear local pitch session state after completion or abandonment.

tool_signatures.name: pitch_send_message
tool_signatures.description: Relay the founder

tool_signatures.name: pitch_start
tool_signatures.description: Start an external founder pitch session; no internal token required.

tool_signatures.name: pitch_status
tool_signatures.description: Inspect the active external pitch session.

tool_signatures.name: pitch_upload_file
tool_signatures.description: Attach a local file to the active external pitch session.

tool_signatures.name: pref_add
tool_signatures.description: Save a durable user or team preference; procedures belong in skills.

tool_signatures.name: pref_list
tool_signatures.description: List standing agent preferences.

tool_signatures.name: pref_set_status
tool_signatures.description: Activate or retire a standing preference.

tool_signatures.name: read_deal
tool_signatures.description: Read one Deal. Live Page is current human-visible state; Information is memory and never updates Page automatically. Use artifactId to read original source text with page/paragraph anchors. Continue with nextOffset and source.sha256. Page field semantics come from agent_bootstrap, not every Deal read.

tool_signatures.name: search_deals
tool_signatures.description: Search compact Live Deal Page candidates. Always use this before creating a company.

tool_signatures.name: skills_read
tool_signatures.description: Read one authenticated runtime skill by slug.

tool_signatures.name: skills_search
tool_signatures.description: Search authenticated runtime skills; read only the relevant result.

tool_signatures.name: update_deal_memory
tool_signatures.description: Replace the complete Markdown Deal Story with one coherent current understanding; never append an update log, restate Live Deal Page/Deal Information fields, or write when understanding would not materially improve. Frontmatter must contain matching deal_id plus stable uuid and created timestamps; updated must strictly advance. Pass the version from get_deal_memory for every returned Story, including a placeholder; only 404 permits creation without expected_version.

tool_signatures.name: wiki_delete
tool_signatures.description: Soft-delete a Wiki article.

tool_signatures.name: wiki_read
tool_signatures.description: Read one Wiki article. format=text extracts its original upload or page body. attachment follows an ID listed in attachments. Continuations require offset and sha256.

tool_signatures.name: wiki_restore
tool_signatures.description: Restore a soft-deleted Wiki article.

tool_signatures.name: wiki_save
tool_signatures.description: Create or update cross-Deal institutional knowledge, not Deal data.

tool_signatures.name: wiki_search
tool_signatures.description: Search institutional knowledge in the internal Wiki.

tool_signatures.name: write_deal
tool_signatures.description: The only Deal mutation tool. Pass one command: input.submit, information.put, page.patch, or artifact.put. Before artifact.put, read Deal files: reuse artifactId for a revision; a same-kind/title collision without an ID returns OCCAM_CONFLICT. Titles are candidates, not identity. Select the intended existing ID from the request/content, or explicitly generate a fresh UUID for a distinct same-name source. Send complete revised bytes, preserve applicable metadata, and verify the ID/version. Core hosts text/html in Command; do not mirror HTML to Drive or require a Drive link. Non-HTML source files, including original transcripts and recordings, go to Drive through artifact.put. Keep source-file bodies out of Input, Information, Page and metadata; save extracted facts and summaries with source references and preserve the user request. page.patch does not edit file bytes. All Page content fields are Agent-writable; author controls attribution, not permission. Before page.patch, use get_live_deal_page_schema for the exact fields being changed and write bilingual Page prose. page.patch is JSON Merge Patch: arrays replace whole arrays, so read-modify-write and preserve sibling slots. A Llama user
